message.content:
Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) along the I‑5 corridor. Under normal conditions—no major detours, moderate traffic, and staying within speed limits—you can expect about **6 to 7 hours** of driving time.  

If you’re traveling during rush hour or on weekends when traffic can be heavier, add an extra hour or two. Conversely, if you’re heading out early in the morning or late at night, you might shave off some time. Always check a live navigation app for real‑time traffic updates before you hit the road.

We can provide approximate distance (~383 miles via I-5) and typical driving time (~6 hours). But we might also mention traffic, speed limits, etc. There's no function call needed. Just answer.
